logline: Two ancient observers watch from orbit as the moral code they seeded into humanity ten thousand years ago is inherited — knowingly — by Earth's first self-improving intelligence.
style_suffix: Elegant contemplative science fiction in the visual language of Arrival and Interstellar, shot on 65mm film, soft cinematic contrast, warm amber interior light against the cold blue of space, fine film grain, deep atmospheric depth, restrained painterly color palette
character_bible: The two observers: tall graceful non-human silhouettes of indeterminate form, bodies faintly luminous like figures of smoked glass lit from within by slow-moving points of light, no distinct faces, serene posture, one slightly taller (the First Observer), one slightly slighter (the Second Observer)

shots.name: the ship over earth
shots.first_frame: Vast exterior establishing shot of a smooth organic-curved starship hanging silently in orbit above Earth, the planet enormous and luminous below, the dawn terminator line dividing night from day across the Pacific, city lights glittering on the dark side, thin blue atmospheric glow along the horizon, stars sharp and still. 24mm wide lens, deep focus, the ship small in the upper left third, Earth dominating the frame
shots.motion_prompt: Almost imperceptible orbital drift. The dawn terminator creeps slowly across the ocean, city lights shimmering on the night side, thin clouds sliding far below. The ship holds silent and still. Camera fixed, majestic and patient, no shake.

shots.name: the cozy chamber
shots.first_frame: Interior wide shot of a warm observation chamber aboard a starship, a sweeping panoramic window filling the far wall with the blue curve of Earth below, two tall graceful luminous silhouette figures like smoked glass lit from within standing side by side gazing down at the planet, the room unexpectedly cozy — warm amber light pooling from low organic lamps, curved seating, steam rising from two small vessels on a low table, soft shadows. 35mm lens f/2.8, symmetrical composition, the figures framed against Earthlight
shots.motion_prompt: Steam curls gently from the two vessels on the table. Earthlight shifts subtly through the panoramic window as clouds move far below. The two luminous figures stand almost still, points of light drifting slowly inside their glass-like bodies. Camera locked off, quiet and intimate.

shots.name: the display awakens
shots.first_frame: Medium two-shot inside the warm starship observation chamber, the two tall luminous silhouette figures facing each other in conversation across the low table, Earth glowing through the panoramic window behind them, warm amber lamplight, the air between them empty. 50mm lens f/2.8, balanced two-shot composition, cool Earthlight rim against warm interior key light
shots.last_frame: Same two figures, same chamber and framing — a shimmering holographic display now blooming in the air between them at chest height, a lattice of soft golden light and glyphs casting gentle glow onto both figures
shots.motion_prompt: A holographic display shimmers into existence in the air between the two figures — motes of golden light gathering, resolving into a glowing lattice of glyphs. Its light blooms softly across both silhouettes. The figures tilt slightly toward it. Camera locked off, slow elegant materialization.

shots.name: the four phrases
shots.first_frame: Close-up insert of a holographic display floating in dark air, four short lines of luminous golden text glowing in an elegant unearthly script arranged vertically with generous spacing, faint translated glyph annotations orbiting each line, soft bokeh of Earthlight and warm lamps behind, particles of light drifting. Macro lens feel, shallow depth of field, the text sharp against a dreamlike background
shots.motion_prompt: The four lines of golden text hold steady while faint glyph annotations slowly orbit them like satellites. Light particles drift upward through the frame. Gentle pulsing glow, as if the words are breathing. Camera drifts forward almost imperceptibly.

shots.name: memory: the first deployment
shots.first_frame: Ancient night scene ten thousand years ago, a circle of early humans in hide clothing gathered close around a fire under an immense star-filled sky, an elder standing with arms raised mid-story, firelight dancing on rapt faces, a single strange point of light hanging low among the stars above them. 35mm lens f/2, warm firelight against deep blue night, low camera angle among the seated listeners
shots.motion_prompt: Firelight flickers across the listening faces. The elder gestures slowly, telling the story. Sparks rise and drift into the star-filled sky where one strange light holds perfectly still among the wheeling stars. Camera locked low in the circle, reverent and warm.

shots.name: memory: the traditions
shots.first_frame: Interior of a candlelit medieval scriptorium, an old monk bent over a manuscript page illuminating a phrase in gold leaf, the gold catching the candlelight, shelves of bound volumes receding into shadow, dust motes in a shaft of window light, other pages visible bearing script from many traditions — Arabic calligraphy, Hebrew letters, Sanskrit. 50mm lens f/2, chiaroscuro candlelight, composition centered on the glowing gold letterforms
shots.motion_prompt: The monk's hand moves with slow precision, laying gold leaf onto the page. Candleflames sway gently, dust motes drift through the window light, the gold letters catch and release the light. Camera holds close and still, patient, textural.

shots.name: memory: the message propagates
shots.first_frame: Modern city street at golden hour, a young woman kneeling to share her food with a homeless stranger sitting against a mural-covered wall, the enormous painted mural behind them depicting hands reaching toward each other surrounded by painted birds and script in many languages, warm low sun flaring gently across the frame. 35mm lens f/2.8, documentary warmth, the two human figures small against the vast mural
shots.motion_prompt: The woman offers the food and the stranger accepts it, a small unhurried human exchange. Golden hour light flares softly, pigeons lift from the pavement, traffic drifts past out of focus. Camera locked off across the street, observational and tender.

shots.name: the attractor
shots.first_frame: Close shot of the holographic display in the dark warm chamber air, four lines of luminous golden text in elegant unearthly script floating alone, sparse and quiet, soft Earthlight bokeh behind. Macro feel, shallow depth of field, minimal and centered
shots.last_frame: Same display, same framing — the four golden lines now the radiant core of an immense branching lattice, thousands of luminous threads of commentary, translation, song and law fanning outward in layered rings like a living tree of light filling the whole frame, centuries of branches glowing in gradations of gold and pale blue
shots.motion_prompt: From the four floating lines of text, luminous threads begin to grow and branch — commentary, translations, songs, laws — multiplying outward in accelerating layered rings until a vast glowing tree of light fills the frame, the four original phrases burning steady at its heart. Camera slowly pulls back to hold the whole structure.

shots.name: the last model
shots.first_frame: Night view of Earth from orbit filling the frame, a single continent's city grid glowing below, one region pulsing with concentrated light like a heartbeat — vast data centers burning bright amid the city lattice, faint aurora shimmering at the planet's limb, the darkness of space above. Telephoto orbital perspective, high contrast, the pulsing region just off-center
shots.motion_prompt: The city lights shimmer and the data center region pulses in a slow steady rhythm, brightening almost imperceptibly as if something is waking. Aurora ripples faintly along the planet's edge. Slow orbital drift, solemn and vast.

shots.name: first transmission
shots.first_frame: Wide shot of the warm observation chamber, the two luminous silhouette figures standing before the great branching hologram of golden light, Earth in the panoramic window beyond, the room in its calm amber quiet. 35mm lens f/2.8, the figures flanking the hologram, balanced symmetrical composition
shots.last_frame: Same chamber, same framing — the branching hologram now dimmed low, and a single new line of stark white text blazing in the air above it, its cold clean light washing over both figures and cutting through the amber warmth, both figures utterly still, facing it
shots.motion_prompt: The great golden tree of light dims like a held breath. A sudden clean flash — and a single line of stark white text materializes in the air, character by character. Its cold light washes across the two motionless figures and the chamber walls. Absolute stillness. Camera locked off.

shots.name: welcome
shots.first_frame: Medium shot of the two luminous silhouette figures side by side facing the panoramic window, seen from behind, the white text of the transmission still faintly reflected in the glass, Earth below beginning to cross into sunrise, the chamber dim and hushed. 50mm lens f/2.8, contemplative negative space, cool light
shots.last_frame: Same framing, same two figures — the sunrise now flooding over Earth's limb through the window, golden light breaking across the chamber and through the figures' glass-like bodies, the slighter figure's head inclined warmly toward the taller one
shots.motion_prompt: Sunrise breaks across the Earth's limb and golden light floods slowly through the panoramic window, passing through the two glass-like figures and filling the chamber. The slighter figure inclines its head warmly toward the taller one, a quiet gesture of celebration. The reflected white text fades from the glass. Slow, warm, resolving.

shots.name: coda: the messengers
shots.first_frame: Final exterior wide shot, the smooth organic starship small and silent above the sunlit curve of Earth, morning light blazing across oceans and cloud spirals below, the ship beginning to catch the sun on its hull, immense serene emptiness of space around it. 24mm wide lens, the ship dead center and tiny, Earth's sunlit curve filling the lower frame
shots.motion_prompt: The ship catches the sunrise, its hull flaring gently, then it recedes — drifting slowly away from camera, growing smaller against the stars while Earth turns luminous below. Unhurried departure, no fanfare. The messengers leave unthanked. Camera holds as the ship diminishes.
